staticFlowAudit.path: Fresh-save route gathered wood twice and stone once through visible forest/mine controls before the store craft. Immediate notices and the combined event-log view are saved in this attempt.

Fresh-save route gathered the starterSpear inputs and crafted at the store workbench. The immediate success notice showed +10 XP from the live crafting plan; screenshot starter-spear-craft-feedback.png and probe-results.json capture the exact notice. No later post-cap craft was attempted: reaching the practice cap requires multiple additional full material batches and stamina/rest cycles, so it is not cheap on this fresh route.
